versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Asset Library Skill, providing a main entry point when users express an end-to-end intent or are unsure which phase to run.
- Routes user requests to the minimal necessary child skill based on intent and available inputs.
- Explains current boundaries, missing inputs, and next steps; guides first-time installation or missing setup to references/install.md.
- Does not directly invoke MCP tools or combine multiple sub-skills in a single execution.
- Emphasizes verification of installation, key/config readiness, and retrieval environment before proceeding.
